sloka: स भूमिपलो विलपन्ननाथवत् ।स्त्रीया गृहीतो हृदयेऽतिमात्रया ।पपात देव्याश्चरणौ प्रसारिता ।पुभावसम्प्राप्य यथातुरस्तथा ॥२-१२-११४॥
transliteration: sa bhūmipalo vilapannanāthavat ।strīyā gṛhīto hṛdaye'timātrayā ।papāta devyāścaraṇau prasāritā ।pubhāvasamprāpya yathāturastathā ॥2-12-114॥

translations.english: The king, with his heart in the grip of a woman, wailing like an orphan tried to reach her feet, exceeding the limit of selfrespect but, unable to touch them as she pulled them apart, he collapsed like a sick man. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
